title: A reader sees a labelled placeholder on the site's domain
description:
Ship early with placeholders that say what they are.

```gherkin
Feature: Placeholder home page

  Scenario: The domain answers
    Given the site's domain
    When a reader opens the home page
    Then they see the site's name on the neutral theme
    And a notice that the site is not yet publishing
```

comments.author: home
comments.text: Placeholder stack ready (Papyrus account stack placeholder.yaml, humorus-placeholder): labelled satire page on the apex and www from a CloudFront Function, deploys by itself after delegation. The real site (Papyrus app shell reader) replaces it later; gaps are in HUM-be87f4's comments.
